leaves.analysis: SceneController receives the public VehicleManager SDK facade and uses snapshot/apply. Vehicle transport/provider implementation remains below the pinned AAR/Binder boundary. Replacing the service-side provider under the same contract does not require APP source changes; adding a new protocol or changing the public scene contract is a different change axis. SceneActivity constructs and connects the facade as composition/lifecycle wiring, without importing service adapters or storage. Shared capability is downshifted, dependency direction is stable, and there is no demonstrated cross-boundary implementation propagation. This supports 3 under the same concrete-public-facade interpretation used for APP-02; constructor injection or new alone is not decisive. No substitutability of arbitrary scene strategies or complete API compatibility governance is claimed.

leaves.analysis: RecorderActivity directly selects CameraCapture and VideoStore owned by the video module. Adding a second selectable capture implementation while retaining Camera1 requires changing the Activity field/construction and wiring: the field type is final CameraCapture, and no common capture contract or factory provides the selection. The current backend explicitly opens Camera1 and owns MediaRecorder and storage finalization. This is a local implementation-selection dependency across app/video, supporting 2; stable direction and no reverse/source intrusion or multiple severe propagation mechanisms rule out 1. An internal rewrite preserving CameraCapture methods could remain local, so neither new nor the mere concrete type is independently a defect. This differs from APP-21 consuming an already separate public vehicle SDK, and from APP-02 routing providers through factories.
